request.description: Creates the improvement rule and its first draft. Staff only, same lifecycle as scoring models. `content`: `scope.segments` (empty = all), `trigger` condition over facts and `score.value`, `factor.<key>.pct|score|attention`, `priority` (lower first), texts `title`, `found`, `why`, `action`, `evidence` with `{{attribute}}` / `{{score.value}}` / `{{factor.<key>.pct}}` placeholders, optional `evidenceDocumentType`.
